scripts.build: tsc -b packages/capture packages/redaction packages/flow packages/overlay packages/eval-harness packages/fixtures packages/cli apps/desktop
scripts.capture:materialize:odoo: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @onboardai/cli onboardai capture materialize odoo
scripts.capture:materialize:notion: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @onboardai/cli onboardai capture materialize notion
scripts.capture:normalize:odoo: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @onboardai/cli onboardai capture normalize odoo
scripts.capture:normalize:notion: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @onboardai/cli onboardai capture normalize notion
scripts.flow:validate: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @onboardai/cli onboardai flow validate flows
scripts.flow:search: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @onboardai/cli onboardai flow search
scripts.eval:odoo: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @onboardai/cli onboardai eval run odoo
scripts.eval:notion: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @onboardai/cli onboardai eval run notion
scripts.proof:fixtures: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @onboardai/cli onboardai proof fixtures
scripts.proof:status: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @onboardai/cli onboardai proof status
scripts.proof:scan: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @onboardai/cli onboardai proof scan-shareable
